name: CILE conceptual near-neighbour calibration set
purpose: Boundary calibration only. These records probe whether search queries drift toward adjacent phenomena. Membership is not an eligibility or exclusion decision.

records.title: The Scale and Impacts of Money Laundering
records.guard_question: Does the work establish a sustained relationship between an identifiable criminal interest and a legal-economy target, rather than laundering effects alone?

records.title: Pecunia Non Olet? The Control of Money-laundering Revisited
records.guard_question: Is legal-economy access, participation, influence, control or embeddedness substantively analysed, rather than money-laundering control in general?

records.title: Money‐Laundering Primer
records.guard_question: Is there relational evidence of infiltration beyond a general description of laundering mechanisms?

records.title: Crime, security and firm performance in South Africa
records.guard_question: Does the criminal actor enter or become embedded in the legal-economy target, rather than merely imposing an external crime or security cost?

records.title: Corporate control and ownership networks
records.guard_question: Is an analytically identifiable criminal interest present, rather than ownership/control structure alone?

records.title: Corporate governance, ownership structure and firm performance of Egyptian listed companies
records.guard_question: Does the study analyse criminal participation or influence, rather than ordinary governance and ownership?

records.title: Impact of corporate ownership and control on firm performance: The Nigerian experience
records.guard_question: Is criminal control or embeddedness demonstrated, rather than corporate ownership effects in general?

records.title: Corporate governance and firm networks: An empirical research based on Italy
records.guard_question: Do the firm networks contain an identified criminal interest and sustained legal-economy relation, rather than network structure alone?

records.title: Using Beneficial Ownership Data for Systematic Risk Assessment in Public procurement. The Example of 6 European Countries
records.guard_question: Does beneficial-ownership risk measurement identify a criminal interest with sustained influence over a legal-economy target, rather than procurement risk or opacity alone?

records.title: Financial architecture of crime: how do factions and militias transform illicit capital into assets?
records.guard_question: Does asset conversion become sustained participation, influence, control or embeddedness in the legal economy, rather than investment of illicit proceeds alone?

records.title: More Schemes and Facilitators
records.guard_question: Does facilitation establish a sustained criminal relationship with a legal-economy target, rather than professional assistance to a predicate or laundering scheme?

records.title: Business Crime versus Organized Crime or Business Crimes as Organized Crime
records.guard_question: Does the work identify organised-crime access, participation, influence, control or embeddedness in a legal-economy entity, rather than business offending as such?
